title: Links and Navigation
description: Understanding how to create links and navigation using the <a> tag.

flashcards.question: What HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
How do you specify the destination URL of a link?
flashcards.answer: Using the href attribute in the <a> tag.

flashcards.question: What attribute opens a link in a new browser tab?
How do you create an internal page link (anchor)?
flashcards.answer: By using an id attribute on the target element and href="#id" in the link.

flashcards.question: What attribute is used to provide a tooltip on hover for a link?
How do you create a mailto link?
Can the <a> tag link to files other than web pages?
flashcards.answer: Yes, it can link to files like PDFs, images, or downloads.

flashcards.question: What is the default behavior of a link if target is not specified?
flashcards.answer: It opens the link in the same tab or window.

flashcards.question: How can you make a link visually stand out as a button?
flashcards.answer: By using CSS styles like background, padding, and border on the <a> tag.

flashcards.question: Why should descriptive link text be used?
flashcards.answer: For better accessibility and SEO, so users and search engines understand the link's purpose.
